integrations.name: Node.js
integrations.description: Detects the Node.js runtime before project setup.

integrations.name: Python
integrations.description: Detects the Python runtime before project setup.

integrations.name: npm
integrations.description: Detects npm before installing JavaScript packages.

requirements.reason: npm installs packages for a Node.js project.

integrations.name: pnpm
integrations.description: Detects pnpm before installing JavaScript packages.

requirements.reason: pnpm installs packages for a Node.js project.

integrations.name: uv
integrations.description: Detects uv before installing Python packages.

requirements.reason: uv installs packages for a Python project.

integrations.name: pip
integrations.description: Detects pip from a requirements file before installing Python packages.

requirements.reason: pip installs packages for a Python project.

integrations.name: Next.js
integrations.description: Scaffolds a Next.js App Router project with create-next-app.

requirements.reason: create-next-app requires Node.js.
create-next-app is bootstrapped with npm or pnpm.

integrations.name: React + Vite
integrations.description: Scaffolds a React app with the official create-vite templates.

requirements.reason: create-vite requires Node.js.
create-vite is bootstrapped with npm or pnpm.

integrations.name: Express
integrations.description: Adds Express 5 with the official Hello World server.

requirements.reason: Express requires Node.js 18 or later.
Express is installed with npm or pnpm.

integrations.name: Fastify
integrations.description: Adds Fastify with the official first-server ESM example.

requirements.reason: Fastify requires Node.js.
Fastify is installed with npm or pnpm.

integrations.name: FastAPI
integrations.description: Adds FastAPI with the official first-steps main.py app.

requirements.reason: FastAPI requires Python.
FastAPI is installed with uv or pip.

integrations.name: Flask
integrations.description: Adds Flask with the official quickstart app.py so flask run works without --app.

requirements.reason: Flask requires Python 3.9 or later.
Flask is installed with uv or pip.

integrations.name: Tailwind CSS
integrations.description: Adds Tailwind CSS v4 using the official Next.js PostCSS or Vite plugin guides.

requirements.reason: Tailwind is added to the scaffolded Next.js or Vite application.

integrations.name: shadcn/ui
integrations.description: Initializes shadcn/ui in an existing Next.js or Vite app.

requirements.reason: shadcn/ui is configured on top of Tailwind CSS.

integrations.name: SQLite
integrations.description: Selects SQLite as a file-based database. RepoSetup does not install a database server.

integrations.name: PostgreSQL
integrations.description: Selects PostgreSQL as the database. RepoSetup does not install a database server.

integrations.name: MongoDB
integrations.description: Selects MongoDB as the database. RepoSetup does not install a database server.

integrations.name: Prisma
integrations.description: Adds Prisma ORM with the SQLite or PostgreSQL driver adapter.

requirements.reason: Prisma needs a selected database. This phase implements SQLite and PostgreSQL.
Prisma is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: Drizzle ORM
integrations.description: Adds Drizzle ORM with the official node-postgres PostgreSQL path.

requirements.reason: This phase implements Drizzle with PostgreSQL (node-postgres) only.
Drizzle is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: Mongoose
integrations.description: Adds Mongoose with the official MongoDB connection helper.

requirements.reason: Mongoose connects to MongoDB.
Mongoose is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: SQLAlchemy
integrations.description: Adds SQLAlchemy with the self-contained Psycopg PostgreSQL driver and engine helper.

requirements.reason: SQLAlchemy is installed into the scaffolded application.
This phase configures SQLAlchemy for PostgreSQL.

integrations.name: Alembic
integrations.description: Adds Alembic and initializes the official alembic/ environment.

requirements.reason: Alembic generates SQLAlchemy migration environments.

integrations.name: Zod
integrations.description: Adds Zod schema validation.

requirements.reason: Zod is installed into the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: Pydantic
integrations.description: Adds Pydantic data validation.

requirements.reason: Pydantic is installed into the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: Pydantic Settings
integrations.description: Adds typed environment settings with a safe .env.example and missing-value tests.

requirements.reason: Pydantic Settings extends the Pydantic model layer.
The generated settings validation sample runs with pytest.

integrations.name: Vitest
integrations.description: Adds Vitest. Next.js uses the official RTL guide; other Node apps install Vitest only.

requirements.reason: Vitest is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: Testing Library
integrations.description: Adds React Testing Library and an accessible interaction test for React + Vite.

requirements.reason: Testing Library samples run with Vitest.

integrations.name: TanStack Query
integrations.description: Adds a React + Vite QueryClient provider and a tested server-state query example.

requirements.reason: The TanStack Query sample uses Testing Library for its browser-level assertion.

integrations.name: Playwright
integrations.description: Adds Playwright Test with create-playwright. Browsers are not downloaded.

requirements.reason: Playwright is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: pytest
integrations.description: Adds pytest as a development dependency. Does not write sample tests.

requirements.reason: pytest is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: ESLint
integrations.description: Adds ESLint with the official flat config recommended rules.

requirements.reason: ESLint is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: Prettier
integrations.description: Adds Prettier with an exact local version and starter config files.

requirements.reason: Prettier is installed into the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: Ruff
integrations.description: Adds Ruff as a development dependency.

requirements.reason: Ruff is added to the scaffolded application.

integrations.name: HTTPX
integrations.description: Adds HTTPX and an in-process FastAPI API response test.

requirements.reason: The HTTPX sample is a pytest API test.

integrations.name: Docker
integrations.description: Documents Docker as a prerequisite. RepoSetup does not install Docker.

integrations.name: Docker Compose
integrations.description: Adds a Compose file for PostgreSQL. RepoSetup does not start containers.

requirements.reason: Compose files are run with Docker.
This phase writes the official PostgreSQL Compose service.

integrations.name: GitHub Actions
integrations.description: Adds a Node.js CI workflow using actions/checkout and actions/setup-node.

requirements.reason: The workflow is added to the scaffolded Node.js application.

presets.name: Next.js + SQLite
presets.description: Next.js, Tailwind, Prisma, SQLite, Zod, Vitest, and Prettier.

presets.name: React + Vite
presets.description: React, Vite, Tailwind, shadcn, Vitest, ESLint, and Prettier.

presets.name: Express + PostgreSQL
presets.description: Express, PostgreSQL configuration, Prisma, Zod, Docker Compose, and Prettier.

presets.name: FastAPI
presets.description: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, pytest, Ruff, and Docker Compose.

presets.name: Flask
presets.description: Flask, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, pytest, Ruff, and Docker Compose.
